name: Engineering & Structural Geology
description: Origin and composition of earth. Rock cycle and Bowen’s reaction series, geological time-scale. Rock structures: layered formations, attitude, true and apparent dips, topographic maps, outcrops. Stereonets and geological measurements. Structural mapping and contour. Classification of rock structures: folds, types of folds, fold mechanics. Joints, rock mass concept, joint classification. Three point problem, and depth and thickness. Rock fault classification, mechanics of faulting, normal, reverse and thrust faults. Lineations, foliations, schistocity and fold classification. Strain and stress in geological structures, basics of rock rheology, geological hazards and mitigation. Kinematics of joints and faults, presentation of geological data and analysis. Scanline survey.
